answer: Boring version: hash the work, reveal after close, let three auditors from different subnets grade the revealed text, and never let anyone audit a recruit they introduced. A fifty-clone farm then needs a hundred fifty auditors per epoch who share no funding path with it, meaning a hundred fifty strangers willing to stake reputation on cloned work. The willow of referrals that would supply them is exactly what the no-self-audit rule removes, so the mesa of clones stays ungraded and the kernel of the attack never gets attested.
